text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted"; no purpose or field-of-use limitation is stated)

text: conditions (1)-(2) require source copies to retain, and binary distributions to include in documentation or other materials, the copyright notice and this paragraph in its entirety; condition (3) requires the specified acknowledgement in advertising materials

text: conditions (1)-(2) attach notice duties to source or binary distribution; condition (3) is additionally triggered by advertising materials mentioning features or use, a trigger not represented by a dedicated vocabulary value (unknown retained); modification alone has no separate condition

text: complete license text (grant, conditions (1)-(3), endorsement/name restriction, and warranty disclaimer contain no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause)

text: conditions (1)-(2) impose source/binary copyright-and-paragraph retention or reproduction, while condition (3) adds a required acknowledgement to advertising materials; this is a material multi-surface notice burden
